description: Takes the lowest, highest and average voltage across the channels of a polyphonic signal, and offers those channels sorted by voltage

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal whose channels are compared

outputs.text: Monophonic, carrying the lowest voltage found across the input channels
Monophonic, carrying the average of the voltages across the input channels
Monophonic, carrying the highest voltage found across the input channels
The input channels sorted from lowest voltage to highest, carrying as many channels as the input
The input channels sorted from highest voltage to lowest, carrying as many channels as the input
